'''Smelting vessels''' were industrial [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. They were commonly sighted at [[the Auction]], a gathering of the underworld to buy [[Starship/Legends|starship]] stolen by [[Shipjacker/Legends|shipjackers]].<ref name="Ship Jackers">{{JournalCite|13|Special Ops: Ship Jackers}}</ref>
